title: Debug Path Visualizer for Failed Requests
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design a compact, interactive visualization for tracing the lifecycle of a failed request through Redwood's serving stack. The Debug Path Visualizer shows the sequence of hops (client -> routing -> model shard -> fallback -> retry -> cache hit/miss -> response) with elapsed time, per-hop cost estimate, and a compact payload inspector. The goal is to make it fast for engineers and SREs to identify root cause (latency hotspot, model degradation, misrouted requests, serialization errors) and to support postmortem links and roll-forward actions (replay, force-fallback, pin model version).
acceptance_criteria: Clickable path timeline that expands each hop into a detail pane
Per-hop metadata: latency, error code, model variant, region, GPU pool id, batch id, cache status
Inline cost estimate per hop and cumulative cost for the request
Payload inspector modal showing request input, model prompts, and redacted sensitive fields with clear redaction markers
Filters: time window, error taxonomy (transport/server/model), region, model family, request size
Prototype validated in usability session with at least 5 engineers with >80% task success for diagnosing a synthetic fault
initial_prototype: Figma interactive prototype: hover-to-preview, click-to-open-detail, keyboard navigation (left/right to scrub), escape to close payload inspector
decisions: Show aggregated cost only at first design pass; per-node exact dollars added as optional column to reduce clutter
Redaction: mark fields as redacted and show structure but not values by default; allow role-based reveal in Private deployments
Default view uses timeline orientation (left-to-right) with option to switch to stacked list for long paths
open_questions: How should we represent KV cache hits vs partial hits for multi-shard requests?
Should retries be grouped into a single collapsible node or listed individually for timeline fidelity?
What RBAC level is required to view unredacted payloads in Dedicated vs Hosted?
tasks: Finalize hi-fi mocks for timeline and expanded detail pane
Define hover states and microcopy for cost and redaction indicators
Create accessible keyboard interaction spec and ARIA annotations
Hand off tokens and annotation assets to Eng for prototype backend endpoints (trace API + payload-safe view)
Run 2 usability sessions with SRE and Platform engineers and iterate
